scenarios.title: With temporary HOME and QUIRKY_HOME and notifications enabled, a background Until-done loop shows the macOS Loop completed, Loop reached its cap and Loop needs you banners with its loop name/detail; disabling notifications suppresses the banners. Use scripted isolated native provider fixtures, never real account homes. The daemon API tests cover policy decisions; this checks only actual system presentation.

Start an Until-done background loop while an unrelated terminal tab is active; keep that tab focused through a fresh-session iteration and crash retry. Neither creation nor replacement conversation may change active tab, window, keyboard focus or foreground application. Run only in fresh temporary HOME and QUIRKY_HOME.
